name: stash
description: Your clipboard, well-groomed. A Chrome/Edge side-panel clipboard manager for IT students.

scripts.typecheck: wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit && npm run desktop:typecheck
scripts.desktop:e2e: npm run desktop:build:test && playwright test -c desktop/playwright.config.ts
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:check-release && electron-builder --dir && npm run desktop:check-fuses
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:check-release && electron-builder --win --x64 && npm run desktop:check-fuses
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:check-release && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.desktop:e2e:packaged: npm run desktop:pack:test && playwright test -c desktop/playwright.packaged.config.ts
